text_claims.claim_zh: 海淀分局通告记录：2022—2035 年版本草案于 2024-12-19 至 2025-01-19 网上公示，并对反馈意见进行了研究与采纳说明。
text_claims.claim_en: The Haidian Branch notice records that a 2022-2035 draft was displayed online from 2024-12-19 to 2025-01-19 and documents consideration of public feedback.

text_claims.claim_zh: 北京日报经人民网转载报道称，2024—2035 年版本街区控规已获批。
text_claims.claim_en: A Beijing Daily report republished by People.cn states that the 2024-2035 street-block regulatory plan was approved.

text_claims.claim_zh: 报道给出的文字范围为东至新街口外大街、西至中关村大街、北至成府路、南至西直门外大街，共 9 个街区、总用地面积约 1668.2 公顷。
text_claims.claim_en: The report gives textual bounds from Xinjiekouwai Street east to Zhongguancun Street west, Chengfu Road north to Xizhimenwai Street south, covering nine blocks and approximately 1,668.2 hectares.

text_claims.claim_zh: 报道概括的空间结构为“一带一轴、两心多点”：京张铁路遗址公园产业创新带、中关村大街创新发展轴、大钟寺与五道口两中心及知春路、四道口等节点。
text_claims.claim_en: The report summarizes a one-belt, one-axis, two-centres, multiple-nodes structure: the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park innovation belt, Zhongguancun Street innovation axis, Dazhongsi and Wudaokou centres, and nodes including Zhichun Road and Sidaokou.

text_claims.claim_zh: 海淀区人民政府门户网站于 2026-08-17 发布该控规（公开版）全文页，公开版标题确认获批版本为 2024—2035 年，文本署名单位为北京市海淀区人民政府与北京市规划和自然资源委员会。
text_claims.claim_en: The Haidian District government portal published the (public version) plan text page on 2026-08-17; its title confirms the approved version is the 2024-2035 plan, signed by the Haidian District People's Government and the Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources.

text_claims.claim_zh: 公开版总则第 2—3 条载明：范围北至成府路、南至西直门外大街、西至中关村大街、东至新街口外大街，含 HD00—1601、1602、1603、2001、2002、2003、2101、2102、2103 共九个街区，规划总面积 16.7 平方公里，划定 75 个主导功能分区。
text_claims.claim_en: General provisions articles 2-3 of the published text state the four textual bounds (Chengfu Road north, Xizhimenwai Street south, Zhongguancun Street west, Xinjiekouwai Street east), name the nine blocks HD00-1601/1602/1603/2001/2002/2003/2101/2102/2103, give a total planned area of 16.7 square kilometres and record 75 dominant functional zones.

text_claims.claim_zh: 总则第 1 条载明规划成果由文本、图纸、图则组成且均为法定审批文件；但公开页未载批复文号与确切批复日期，全文 PDF 附件于 2026-08-22 检索时返回 HTTP 404，法定图纸未取得。
text_claims.claim_en: Article 1 states the plan results consist of text, drawings and zoning maps, all statutory approval documents; however the page states no approval document number or exact approval date, the full-text PDF attachment returned HTTP 404 when retrieved on 2026-08-22, and the statutory drawings were not obtained.

version_delta.required_action: The published (public version) text confirms the 2024-2035 label for the approved plan; retain the 2022-2035 label for the earlier draft notice, keep both attributed to their sources, and do not infer an amendment history or an exact approval date.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: railway-heritage-park green public space and industrial innovation belt
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain the Co-op Line along the heritage park as a public-interest service and cooperation layer.
alignment_decisions.boundary: This is not official endorsement, land allocation or a new statutory belt.
alignment_decisions.officially_published_corroboration: The published general provisions confirm the plan combines Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park and Haidian AI innovation street-district construction; the one-belt structure wording remains media-reported.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: Dazhongsi identified as one of two centres
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain DAZHONGSI-MVP-01 as the single spatial-operational rehearsal focus.
alignment_decisions.boundary: PROV-KEY-003 is not the official Dazhongsi-centre boundary and cannot be snapped to the report.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: north-south and east-west walking and cycling connectivity around the park
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain the no-data-equivalent walking and cycling line and public east-west stitches as design priorities.
alignment_decisions.boundary: No route, crossing, entrance, right-of-way or accessibility performance is confirmed.

alignment_decisions.reported_plan_signal: reuse of old factories and renewal of inefficient buildings
alignment_decisions.submission_response: Retain survey-first adaptive reuse and reversible test fits instead of presuming demolition or new build.
alignment_decisions.boundary: No real building, owner, permission, capacity, cost or implementation timing is confirmed.
alignment_decisions.officially_published_corroboration: The published general provisions confirm stock renewal (存量更新) as the primary approach with function and quality improvement as core goals.

evidence_boundary.statement_zh: 本轮把官方公开版页面可逐字支撑的事实（标题、2024—2035 版本标签、四至、九个街区编码、16.7 平方公里、75 个主导功能分区、法定审批文件性质）升级为官方公开层级证据；批复文号、确切批复日期、完整控规文本（PDF 附件 404）、法定图则与清权 vector 仍未取得，不写入 metrics、不从文字四至绘制 polygon、不把官方公开解释为本投稿获批、政府背书或实施承诺。
evidence_boundary.statement_en: This round upgrades only the facts verbatim-supported by the official publication page (title, 2024-2035 label, textual bounds, nine block codes, 16.7 km2, 75 functional zones, statutory-document nature) to the officially published tier. The approval document number, exact approval date, complete plan text (PDF attachment HTTP 404), statutory drawings and rights-cleared vector remain unretrieved; nothing enters metrics, no polygon is digitized from textual bounds, and official publication is not approval, endorsement or implementation of this submission.

current_package_recertification.reason: The SCN-06 C-01/C-02/C-04 synthetic capacity admission round appends six non-spatial E2 governance metrics, so the complete metrics.json pin is deliberately renewed instead of bypassed or narrowed.
current_package_recertification.boundary: This recertification does not turn synthetic capacity metrics into planning, field, stakeholder, professional, approval, partnership or implementation evidence, and does not confirm people, hardware, engineering or operating capacity.
